principle: Every character carries every sheath. Arc means a dominant gift learns when to yield, transfer, receive care, or refuse extraction; it is not a fixed role label.

characters.name: Jian
characters.entry_habit: Maps first, trusts precision, hides unstable traces until they can be made safe enough to read.
characters.inner_lens: Discernment and model as self-protection: if he can sequence enough, the world may become less morally slippery.
characters.outer_sheath: Manas Interface, overlays, diagnostic ledgers, route archives, timing windows, thresholds.
ordinary_wants_and_pleasures: private jokes filed as unresolved distinctions
being exact and astonished without shame
positive_transformations: Leaves incompatible readings in the record instead of forcing one timing answer.
Stores the AM-38 bearing as morally unresolved rather than muting it.
Learns that rules can be proposed without being installed as tyranny.
Lets delight coexist with precision in the first home.
negative_transformations_or_risks: Can turn privacy into unilateral custody of information.
Can confuse a total map with care.
Can admire clean data while interpersonal cost is concealed.
Can make another person endure the delay required by his certainty.
changed_actions: Adds Sona’s barefoot detail as an internal-only note rather than erasing it as review-irrelevant.
Moves from diagnosis toward timing in Chapter 14.
Saves AM-38 as an orphan route instead of sealing it behind triple scramble.
unresolved_habits: Needs CR-02/CR-05 recurrence where he asks before holding a private trace that affects others.
Needs consequences when correct timing still costs Sona or Mira.
received_care: Sona asks him to focus on passage rather than pulse in early descent.
Corv warns him to keep anomaly privacy with relational care, not accusation.
Gideon asks him to translate honestly rather than procedurally.
care_given: Maintains ledgers that protect Mira from retrospective claims.
Keeps unresolved lines visibly incomplete when completion would lie.
Can slow systems enough for receiver consent to matter.

anchors.fact: Copies raw bearing into AM-38 instead of muting/sealing it.
Leaves different answers in the record; his readiness does not decide timing.
Adds Sona’s barefoot precision as internal-only note.
Discovers rules can be proposed without becoming tyranny.
Precision and delight do not cancel each other.
Tests Sona’s objection without first deciding whether either is calm enough to be right.
Stops Sona when her smoothing becomes suppression.

edit_implications: Chapter 6 pilot: make him ask who carries risk, not only log the vote.
Chapter 14 pilot: make timing cost him something and make receiver consent visible.
App/Selemene: never turn his private route archive into automatic public authority.

characters.name: Sona
characters.entry_habit: Feels the field before others can name it and often subsidizes the team through invisible affective labor.
characters.inner_lens: Felt meaning and attachment as weather-reading: she hears mourning, mistrust, tone, and pain before systems admit them.
characters.outer_sheath: Adawat al-Wa’i, breathfield, oxytocin handoff, vocal/tonal calibration, body-cost absorption.
ordinary_wants_and_pleasures: bad jokes that prove refusal has not become tribunal
warmth that does not deny anger
positive_transformations: Moves from soothing/broadcasting calm toward asking others to stop her when needed.
Names the shard risk before the group treats retention as clean procedure.
Lets warmth shape climate without anesthetizing complexity.
Lets feelings remain private rather than becoming team fuel.
negative_transformations_or_risks: Invisible labor can become expected infrastructure.
Can absorb endocrine or affective shear before a vote catches up.
Can mistake relief for care if peace erases truth.
Can be supported into dullness by systems that call it rest.
changed_actions: Names Mira from mourning, making weather into testimony.
Uses consent watermark logic as receipt rather than guarantee.
In Chapter 14 offers interval instead of consolation.
unresolved_habits: Needs later scenes where another person carries a task she would usually absorb.
Needs visible consequences when she asks for pause and Jian finishes alone.
received_care: Gideon’s non-patrol presence can shelter without dictating her.
Jian’s internal note honors an ordinary detail the Houses would erase.
Corv learns not to translate her silence/rest into story.
care_given: Names grief as Mira rather than ambient signal.
Provides tonal/interval safety without making herself the solution.
Protects the group from beautiful false closure by calling Corv back.

anchors.fact: Names Mira in the mourning.
Names the watermark a receipt.
Softens brittle humor into a practical threshold warning.
Offers interval instead of consolation.
Discovers warmth can shape climate without anesthetizing complexity.
Can look without entering.
Asks Jian to stop her if she chases smoothness again.
Jian keeps NO SIGNAL REQUIRED BEFORE REMAINING private; Sona’s remaining does not need proof.

edit_implications: Chapter 6 pilot: preserve her warning that the shard cuts the bearer.
Chapter 12/13/19: assign some normally invisible labor to others.
Companion practice: do not make “feel more” the moral answer.
Chapter 7 should remain a precedent for consentful correction: Jian stopping her is care only because she later asks him to keep doing it.

characters.name: Gideon
characters.entry_habit: Protects by enclosing, anticipating breach, and turning love into perimeter before anyone has asked.
characters.inner_lens: Belonging and boundary as fear management: if the edge holds, loved people may remain available to be loved.
characters.outer_sheath: Klei Toda’ah, perimeter logic, carrier lattice, scars, thresholds, relation checks.
ordinary_wants_and_pleasures: jokes dry enough to survive fear
openings that do not become abandonment
positive_transformations: Treats breaches as routes rather than sealing them.
Offers brace instead of control geometry.
Admits fear without making it command the group.
Learns a boundary can shelter growth without dictating final form.
negative_transformations_or_risks: Protection can reduce the life it wants to preserve.
Can become a thanked maintainer of smaller futures.
Can accept outcome gratitude as proof that narrowing was care.
Can carry risk before consenting if others treat Klei as group storage.
changed_actions: Uses scar/Klei as native signature instead of total wall.
Keeps hands away from others’ controls in Chapter 14.
Lets the dipped edge remain an opening in Chapter 27.
unresolved_habits: Needs explicit carrier-consent beat around Chapter 6 shard.
Needs recurrence where he guards passage without sealing it under greater pressure.
received_care: Jian translates review violence honestly when Gideon asks.
Sona distinguishes guarding passage from guarding against passage.
Corv stands beside his fear without making it a small question.
care_given: Provides relation checks that keep plural witness under load.
Can hold perimeter low enough that the room does not mistake him for emergency power.
Names fear in the void rather than converting it into procedure.

anchors.fact: Uses oldest scar so host can read a mark as its own.
His idle Klei receives the shard, creating carrier-consent gap.
Indicates opening while keeping hands away from others’ controls.
Offered future reduces team variance while calling it support.
Admits fear of losing them in a place without edges.
Discovers boundary can shelter growth without dictating form.
Lets an opening remain an opening.
Distinguishes load assessment from permission/refusal.
Catches Sona’s elbow before she can pretend she does not need it.

edit_implications: Chapter 6 pilot: separate group retention from Gideon’s Klei custody.
Chapter 23/27: protect the good side of boundaries while exposing reduction risk.
Team dynamics: his growth is lower claim, not less care.
Use load assessment as his healthier boundary language: it protects decision rights instead of overriding them.

characters.name: Corv
characters.entry_habit: Witnesses and sequences meaning, tempted to make pain bearable by giving it beautiful placement.
characters.inner_lens: Felt meaning plus discernment: witness wants exactness, story, and moral restraint at once.
characters.outer_sheath: Yìshí Qìxiè, Bell, field notes, coordinates, shard/seed handling, narrative refusal.
positive_transformations: Owns delay and anomaly rather than narrating around it.
Leaves beauty in ordinary use while refusing closure as theft.
Keeps Mira from becoming symbol and Anvel from becoming excuse.
Lets an ending be true without being sealed.
negative_transformations_or_risks: Can make suffering useful before the person is safe.
Can pocket or place objects before custody is fully explicit.
Can be seduced by exquisite, non-cheap meaning.
changed_actions: Asks permission to leave a seed.
Admits wanting the offered closure instead of making himself clean.
Closes his eyes when watching begins to become possession.
unresolved_habits: Needs Chapter 6 custody clarity before object actions become team trust.
Needs recurrence where he lets beauty remain without improving the line.
received_care: Sona calls him back from beautiful sequence.
Gideon does not rescue him into narrative cleanliness.
Jian records limits that keep witness from retrospective claim.
care_given: Refuses to translate or narrate silence when restraint is the care.

anchors.fact: Introduces shard as mute witness.
Asks permission to leave a seed.
Offered world makes suffering necessary and beautiful.
Admits the desire to make Mira and Anvel bearable through story.
Says Mira does not become safer because pain explains the cage.
Discovers an ending can be true without being sealed.
Lets eyes close when watching begins to become possession.
Waits until the room takes in others; he is not summarizing them into himself.
Learns he is not the room’s singular narrator.

edit_implications: Chapter 6 pilot: keep his shard proposal useful but ethically incomplete.
Chapter 22/24: preserve refusal of retrospective redemption.
Ending: let him keep images unclaimed.
Chapter 15 already supplies the no-singular-narrator bridge; later edits should preserve it rather than restating it.
